asset_verification: Compared the four downloads to the locally built assets, checked release and tag identity against GitHub, and checked every ZIP entry against the release manifest.
local_checks: fevc/tools/run_checks.py passed on local Stata/MP 19, including 1,033 Python tests, generated CMG sources, Stata quick/full suites, clean installation, helper migration and benchmark smoke tests.
fevc/tools/build_github_release.py validated the native adoption and Windows evidence and built an identical ZIP from the version commit and tag commit.
fevc/tools/verify_native_installers.py passed on fresh and replacement ZIP installations, including native/default inference, pooled component and caller-state regressions.
installation_checks: Each isolated install checked the reported 0.6.1 version, native capability, the automatic and forced normal intervals on help fixture ex4, estat inference, the highrank covariance and leading-direction results, and all installed file hashes. Replacement repaired a modified help file.
scope: Public installation checks ran on macOS arm64 with Stata 19. Stata 15.1 Rosetta installation and display-regression checks and the scope of the reused binary qualification are recorded in compatibility.json.
